name: Calla
source:
Silent... Stoic... Fine with being alone?
The moody one who acts out to get attention when she's lonely!!

A husky that the protagonist is watching over, adopted by his parents after he left home. She often acts alone. It may seem like her personality doesn't mesh with the other dogs, but she simply marches by the beat of her own drum. 
She's elusive. Even if she goes out with the protagonist, she'll suddenly disappear only to go back home on her own or something of the sort. Sometimes she suddenly gets clingy with the protagonist, and other times she ignores him no matter what he says. 
She'll start confidently on something only to fail dismally. If you try to do something to please her, she'll freeze up. This dog is quiet yet audacious.

"I'm tired. ...Give me a piggyback ride."
